summary: The floating-card icon language, inline AI OS treatment and three device compositions require another full correction round.
requiredCorrection: Replace the inconsistent third-card icons with a deliberate identity-led system whose position, colour and optical size are coherent.
Render inline AI OS as the product disc followed by text, never as text on a gradient-filled label.
Rework the device compositions so each supplied hardware mockup is scaled and positioned from its visible subject rather than its transparent canvas.
Render the new round and inspect the mockup variants before presenting them.
